fields.summary_ko.0: Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) plunged 12% on Friday to $306.55 on reports of Google scaling back AI chip plans, with market capitalization declining by $19.1 billion.
fields.summary_ko.1: According to supply chain research by analyst Ming-Chi Kuo, Google reduced 2027 TPU 8i series shipments by approximately 1 million units (about 20%).
fields.summary_ko.2: Goldman Sachs lowered its price target from $540 to $460, while Rothschild & Co Redburn downgraded from $595 to $398.
